blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A late-night fire on Wednesday in Lapu-Lapu City razed 9 houses and killed a 53-year-old man in Purok Kangkong, Brgy. Gun-ob in Lapu-Lapu City. Authorities identified the dead victim as Charlito Collantes, 53, a resident of Purok Kangkong, and a person with disability (PWD). Collantes was trapped in his house at the height of the fire at past 9 p.m. on Nov. 4. According to the Lapu-Lapu City Rescue, the victim was bedridden and could not get out the house when it burned. Aside from the death, seven persons were also hurt in the fire. READ: All […]... Keep on reading: Lapu-Lapu fire razes 9 houses, traps, kills PWD in Gun-ob
